confidence.meaning: The figure is supported well enough to prioritize investigation, not to commit a budget against.

destination.statement: Act first in the named org unit: it carries the reporting period's recoverable-spend scenario.

figure.label: Recoverable AI spend indicated for the reporting period (routing scenario, not a realized saving)

limits.statement: The recoverable figure is a routing scenario, not a realized saving. Nothing here has been banked, and no invoice has changed.
This briefing was built in your browser from derived workspace records only. No import, prompt, file, or credential was read, and nothing was uploaded.
This briefing cannot produce a shareable link. There is no link form that could carry imported records, and none is offered.
Every figure is USD. No exchange rate is applied, so a workspace holding another currency is not comparable here.
The benchmark is this workspace's own trailing history. No peer, industry, or market cohort is implied by any figure.
